topic: Physical Properties of Matter: Shape, Size, and Weight
key_concepts: Matter is anything that can be seen, felt, smelled, tasted, or heard
Matter occupies space and has weight
Objects have different shapes such as square, rectangle, triangle, and circle
Objects can be grouped according to shape
A ruler or meter stick is used to measure size
Size is measured in inches or meters
A weighing scale is used to measure weight
Weight is measured in pounds, kilograms, or grams
Objects can be compared as heavier, lighter, or equal in weight
The senses help describe the physical characteristics of objects
